item.title: Over 20M Americans set to lose healthcare coverage Jan. 1 after Congress goes on recess
item.description: Health insurance premiums are expected to more than double or even triple for some 20 million people, pricing many out of healthcare coverage entirely.

item.title: Why is the United States drawn to war?
item.description: The financial kings, the bankers and billionaires, need make only one little mistake in order for the chain of command to be handed over to the military in the United States.

item.title: Trump admin orders pause of 5 major offshore wind projects on East Coast
item.description: The Trump administration said there will be a 90-day pause to allow the Interior Department and other agencies to work with project developers to determine if the perceived security threats can be mitigated.

item.title: 10 good things that happened in 2025
item.description: Let's look back on 2025 as the year movements for peace and justice freed political prisoners, slowed the war machine, and helped turn the public against endless wars.
